name: Huge word carousel
what: One huge word fills the frame and slowly shrinks; then it slides out to the left, smeared by motion blur and shrinking, while the next word flies in from the right, big at first, and settles; the old word stays at the edge as a soft sliver. It happens twice, for three words.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f0-f17 (00:00:00:00-00:00:00:17) word 1 still; f17-f54 (00:00:00:17-00:00:01:24) it shrinks slowly from 100 % to 92 %; f55-f72 (00:00:01:25-00:00:02:12) it slides out to the left shrinking to 69 % with a sideways blur while word 2 flies in from the right (f60-f72) at 121 % and settles at 93 %, word 1 left as a blurred sliver at the left edge; f72-f109 (00:00:02:12-00:00:03:19) word 2 shrinks slowly to 87 %; f110-f128 (00:00:03:20-00:00:04:08) the same swap brings word 3 (in f115-f128); f128-f163 (00:00:04:08-00:00:05:13) word 3 shrinks slowly to 86 %

tracks.name: word 1 holds
tracks.what: the first word fills the frame and shrinks slowly
tracks.easing: linear, easing out at the end

tracks.name: swap 1
tracks.what: word 1 slides out to the left, smaller and blurred; word 2 flies in from the right, big at first, and lands
tracks.easing: word 1 accelerating, word 2 decelerating (measured positions, with the reference's stutter)

tracks.name: swap 2
tracks.what: word 2 slides out to the left and stops near the edge; word 3 flies in the same way

tracks.name: word 3 holds
tracks.what: the third word shrinks slowly to the end
